title: NIST WebBook: Glucose is C6H12O6, molecular weight 180.1559 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Glucose as C6H12O6, molecular weight 180.1559 amu, CAS 50-99-7.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Glucose, CAS Registry Number 50-99-7, lists molecular formula C6H12O6 and molecular weight 180.1559 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 180.0633881 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C6H12O6/c7-1-3(9)5(11)6(12)4(10)2-8/h1,3-6,8-12H,2H2/t3-,4+,5+,6+/m0/s1. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
